structure.type: npm workspaces monorepo (package-lock.json at root), ESM ('type: module')
structure.language: TypeScript (strict, erasableSyntaxOnly; API runs .ts directly via Node native type stripping, no API build step), Vue 3 SFCs in web

workspaces.packages/shared: @crate-digger/shared; zod schemas/sorting; exports ./src/index.ts and ./sorting; scripts: typecheck only
workspaces.apps/api: @crate-digger/api; Fastify 5, better-sqlite3, drizzle-orm (+drizzle-kit, migrations in apps/api/drizzle), sharp, zod type provider; src/{routes,services,plugins,db}; scripts: dev, start, typecheck, test, db:*
workspaces.apps/web: @crate-digger/web; Vue 3, Pinia, vue-router, Vite 6; scripts: dev, build, preview, typecheck (vue-tsc), test

structure.build_system: Only apps/web has a build (vite build -> apps/web/dist). API and shared have no build.

docker_ci.Dockerfile: multi-stage node:22-bookworm-slim; builds web, prod deps for api, runtime runs node apps/api/src/server.ts as user node, /data volume, healthcheck /api/health
docker_ci.ci: .github/workflows/ci.yml: job check (npm ci, format:check, lint, typecheck, test, build); job docker (image build + smoke test of /api/health)

structure.other: ESLint 9 flat config (eslint.config.js, vue+ts), Prettier (.prettierrc.json), tsconfig.base.json; docs/ (SPEC, DEPLOY, 3 ADRs); .env.example

tests.runner: vitest ^3.2 in apps/api (node env, no config file, 9 files in apps/api/test) and apps/web (happy-dom via vite.config.ts, 13 colocated *.test.ts files, uses @vue/test-utils); packages/shared has no tests and no test script

commands_from_repo_root.typecheck: npm run typecheck   (tsc --noEmit in shared and api, vue-tsc --noEmit in web)
commands_from_repo_root.test: npm test   (vitest run in api and web)
commands_from_repo_root.test_single_workspace: npm test -w apps/api   |   npm test -w apps/web

absent: lint script in workspaces (lint is root-only)
